title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction of Cases of the Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou Intellectual Property Courts

articles.content_en: Article 2 The Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court shall exercise cross-regional jurisdiction over the cases specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions within Guangdong Province.

Article 3 The intermediate people's courts of Beijing and Shanghai and the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court shall no longer accept intellectual property civil and administrative cases.
Other intermediate people's courts of Guangdong Province shall no longer accept the cases specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions.
The primary people's courts of Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangdong Province shall no longer accept the cases specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions.

Article 4 Where the subject matter of a case contains both the contents specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions and other contents, jurisdiction shall be determined in accordance with Articles 1 and 2 of these Provisions.

Article 6 Where a party files an appeal against a first-instance civil or administrative judgment or ruling concerning copyright, trademarks, technology contracts, unfair competition, or other intellectual property matters rendered by a primary people's court in the city where the Intellectual Property Court is located, the appeal case shall be tried by the Intellectual Property Court.

Article 7 Appeal cases filed by a party against a first-instance judgment or ruling made by an Intellectual Property Court, and cases where a party applies to the next higher people's court for reconsideration according to law, shall be tried by the intellectual property adjudication division of the Higher People's Court in the place where the Intellectual Property Court is located, except for those that shall be tried by the Supreme People's Court according to law.

Article 8 Cases specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions that have been accepted but not yet concluded by the primary people's courts in the province (municipality directly under the Central Government) where an Intellectual Property Court is located before the establishment of that Intellectual Property Court shall continue to be tried by such primary people's courts.
Except for the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court, cases specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions that have been accepted but not yet concluded by other intermediate people's courts of Guangdong Province before the establishment of the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court shall continue to be tried by such intermediate people's courts.
